nom: PMD Clean Acne - Blue Light Therapy Spot Treatment

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the device visibly reduces pore congestion and breakouts with regular use, with one noting her pores clog up again within a day if she skips a session.
segments.combination: The reviewers with combination skin, several also sensitive or acne-prone, report calmer skin and fewer breakouts and blackheads, though one found the brush shape awkward for cleansing around her oily nose area.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin report calmer, less congested skin when starting on the gentle vibration setting, but one reviewer had a silicone allergy that left her skin red, burnt-looking and itchy, and professionals recommend easing in gradually to avoid irritation.
segments.mature: The reviewers describing mature or aging-prone skin report the device declogs pores and is gentle enough for that skin, without reporting any effect on wrinkles or firmness.
segments.normal: The one reviewer with normal-to-sometimes-sensitive skin found the silicone bristles lightweight and soft and started on the gentle vibration mode to test it.

concerns.blemishes: The large majority describe blemishes and breakouts visibly shrinking or clearing within a few days to a few weeks of regular use, including cystic and hormonal acne in some reported cases. Against this, one reviewer specifically doesn't recommend it for cystic acne since the light doesn't reach that deep, and a handful never got to judge the effect because their unit malfunctioned or failed on first use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily, congestion-prone skin report visibly less clogging and fewer breakouts with regular use, with one noting her pores clog up again within a day if she skips a session.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report reduced redness around blemishes and, for rosacea or broken capillaries, a visible fading of red or purple veins with weeks of consistent use. On the other side, overusing the brush on one spot or a reaction to the silicone is reported to cause redness and irritation.
concerns.barrier: The one reviewer who mentions the skin barrier directly says the cleansing side gives a deep clean without aggravating it.
concerns.spots: The one reviewer who raises scarring, a longtime esthetician, reports the blue light noticeably reduced scarring caused by ingrown hairs with daily use.

extraits.texte: I followed the instructions, used the light on my face and chest. I went to the mirror and noticed it BURNED my skin on the first use. I have grey circles on my face/chest from this product.

I found out I am allergic to silicone after using this. According to Google that is Super Rare. I washed my face with this device at night. I woke up and my face was red, almost looked burnt where i had used it on my face. Super itchy too.. Another side note, it didn't get the sides of my nose clean. That ended up being a good thing with the new found allergy. Not for me.

extraits.titre: Clean Acne - Blue Light Therapy Spot Treatment
extraits.texte: As a licensed cosmetologist I have tried many cleansing brushes. PMD Clean Acne has taken cleansing brushes to the next level. They created a two in one brush that offers blue light therapy and cleaning in one. Charging was super easy to do. The blue light feature has a timer which I loved. I have been using this on acne spots non stop. I hope to see results. The cleansing brush is easy to use. I did see some broken capillaries when using it the first time but was able to use it a few more times without this happening. So go gentle if you start using it to wash your face. I have sensitive skin, rosacea and acne prone as mid thirty year old for reference. PMD Clean Acne has stayed charged for me since using it for the past month. The charger and case are super handy to store.

In my eight years as an esthetician, I have experienced a wide range of brushes designed for cleansing and treating acne. Most other brands designs harbor bacteria, causing more issues than before! PMD tools has absolutely knocked it ojt of the park with the design and functionality of the PMD clean acne cleansing device. The blue light therapy is highly effective at reducing my ingrown hairs that tend to cause scarring. The cleansing function on the brush has 2 speed options which I love to be able to customize my routine daily. My skin has dramatically improved in texture and tone since using this daily. My main concerns have always been my uneven textured skin, large pores, and the redness in my cheeks! Beyond all of the amazing functionality, this brush is so easy to clean and use.

I love the tools from PMD! I am a licensed cosmetologist with 18+ years of experience working in various areas of the skin and cosmetology industry! I've worked specifically in skin care for many years. I have combination skin that leans a bit oily, is sensitive, and acne prone. I also have mild rosacea on my cheeks. I have been dealing with adult acne for the last few years, and go through phases where I'm having a lot of breakouts. I didn't have breakouts when I was younger and there has been a lot of trial and error the last few years to figure out the best routine for my skin. I have been so happy with my tools from PMD! I'm using the PMD Clean Acne, along with the PMD Wave Pro, and I also use their PMD Clean. The PMD Clean Acne has been so helpful with calming my skin and reducing my breakouts/blackheads. My skin feels cleaner, smoother and brighter! I love the silicone brush side for cleansing! It's not harsh but gives a good clean, and is easy to keep sanitized with the silicone bristles. It is such a nice treat to do my self care at the end of the day and really see results.

I have loved skin care since I was young. It only made sense that I became an aesthetician. My passion for skin care overflowed into make up as well as supplemental. I currently work for a naturopath doctor and we help people heal from the inside out. I perform numerous treatments to help slow the aging process. I couldn't love what I do any more and only wish to help more people through my knowledge and training of skin and makeup practices as well as my education on nutritional supplements. I am 36 with three kids and the signs of aging are creeping up faster than I would like! I love to try things to combat that while staying out of a doctors office. Love love love. This tool has done wonders for my clogged pores. The vibration is really the trick to gently, yet effectively cleaning out your pores. I went from congested to bright and light after using this just a few days. I can now tell on days when I do not use it, the next day I am slightly clogged up again from my oily skin which is prone to large pores. I would highly suggest this for teens who are beginning to break out, as well as any age who struggles with over productive oily skin that tends to clog easily. It is gentle enough for the 12-13 year olds, as well as more sensitive aging skin that has congestion. The blue light is also highly effective. Anytime I see a breakout starting or some inflammation I just apply the blue light for the 3 minute timer, and it goes down and looks better after the timer goes off! T

The PMD Clean Acne Facial Cleansing Device is one of the most fantastic facial devices I have ever used. I use it with my favorite cleanser and it is like it has turned a good cleanser into a a turbo deep cleanser! It uses SonicGlow Technology and blue light therapy to erraticate dirt and eliminate acne giving you a super clean appearance. I absolutely love this device it has made a huge difference in my complexion in a short time. I have far less oily skin and haven't had a breakout. I did have a bump feel like it was starting and used the blue light and it did not develop. The vibrations and my cleanser makes my skin feel like I have had a spa treatment at home. Anyone who suffers from oily skin and acne would benefit from this device The blue light technology has been a game changer in my acne treatment.
